title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Bell Buckle grid point, 14-21 October 2016-2025
claims: The requested grid point at 35.5986 N, 86.4017 W returns an elevation of 260 m.
For 14-21 October 2016-2025 (80 day-samples), daily high temperatures ranged from 49.7 to 87.9 degrees F with a median of 71.6 degrees F.
Daily low temperatures ranged from 32.9 to 68.8 degrees F with a median of 49.0 degrees F.
20 of 80 days recorded at least 1 mm of precipitation; 11 of 80 recorded at least 5 mm; the single-day maximum was 28.4 mm.
These are modelled grid-point values, not measurements taken on the race course.

verification.checkedVia: PowerShell Invoke-RestMethod 读取 Open-Meteo archive API JSON，按 10 月 14–21 日过滤样本并重算 min/median/max 与降水计数
verification.note: 2026-11-25 复核：2016–2025 每年 10 月 14–21 日共 80 天；网格点海拔 260 m，与起终点乡村场地接近，但不代表夜间公路段微气候。

claimVerification.note: API 顶层 elevation 字段：260 m。
daily.temperature_2m_max 80 项：重算 min 49.7 / median 71.6 / max 87.9 °F。
daily.temperature_2m_min 80 项：重算 min 32.9 / median 49.0 / max 68.8 °F。
daily.precipitation_sum 80 项：≥1mm 20 天，≥5mm 11 天，最大 28.4 mm。
API 历史再分析数据口径；非赛道实测。
